verdict.rationale: Avalara documents 200+ country tax-rate/rule coverage, a dedicated VAT Reporting product for cross-jurisdiction VAT filing, AvaTax Cross-Border for duties/import tax, and E-Invoicing for global mandates, plus nexus APIs for tracking tax obligations — showing broad international VAT/GST support beyond just US sales tax. However, there's no explicit mention of EU OSS/IOSS scheme handling, foreign registration threshold monitoring, or country-specific filing workflows for UK/Canada/Australia, and a community source notes that registration and filing still require separate handling per jurisdiction even when using Avalara for calculation. Missing for 10: explicit OSS/IOSS scheme support, automated foreign registration threshold alerts, and independent confirmation that filings for UK/Canada/Australia are fully automated end-to-end.
